test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

I found my bag __to lie__ where I had left it.
solution: The correct answer is '**lying**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, '**lying**' should be used instead of **'to lie'.** • '**Lie**' means **'to be or to stay at rest in a horizontal position'.** • '**Lying**' is the gerund form of '**Lie**'. • *Example: **lie** motionless...* • Thus, the correct answer is '**lying**'. **Correct Sentence:__** *I found my bag lying where I had left it.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Gerunds **are formed by adding **'-ing' **to the verb: '**sleeping**, '**drawing**,' '**swimming**.' But they are not the **'-ing' **verb forms that you see in the present or past continuous tense. They look the same, but gerunds are actually verb forms used as nouns. • Let’s take the infinitive of the verb **“to sleep”** and use it in two different sentences: • I am **sleeping**. • This is the present continuous. “**Sleeping**” here is part of the verb. It is not a gerund. Here’s the second sentence: • I don’t like **sleeping**. • This is present simple, but it contains a gerund. “**Sleeping**” is the direct object of this sentence. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ '**to lie**' के स्थान पर '**lying**' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • '**Lie**' का अर्थ है 'एक सहायक सतह पर क्षैतिज या आराम करने की स्थिति में होना'। • '**Lying**' '**Lie**' का **gerund form** है। • *Example: **lie** motionless...* • इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर '**lying**' है। dd:Td32, The erroneous part is **'are wasted'.**
